cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline agricultural decision support for smallholder farmers and extension workers operating with intermittent connectivity and commodity laptops.

test_prompts.prompt: A smallholder maize farmer notices yellowing on older lower leaves while newer leaves remain greener. Give three plausible causes, explain the field observations that would help distinguish them, and suggest low-cost next steps. State uncertainty clearly and say when local agronomic advice is needed.

A farmer with two hectares of maize wants to reduce post-harvest losses without reliable grid power. Propose a practical low-cost drying, handling, and storage plan, including moisture or dryness checks, pest prevention, and warning signs that stored grain is becoming unsafe.
